findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_company, search_companies, find_people · Private data: lookup_company, search_companies, find_people, get_technologies, get_signals, check_usage · Public sink: lookup_company, search_companies, find_people · Destructive: lookup_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_company, search_companies, find_people · Private data: lookup_company, search_companies, find_people, get_technologies, get_signals, check_usage · Public sink: lookup_company, search_companies, find_people · Destructive: lookup_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
